capabilities: Convert a note, selection of folder, or current note to .hwpx
Apply character and paragraph formatting from HWPX template markers
Install and inspect bundled HWPX templates and template guide
Capture Mermaid and SVG blocks as images during export
Expose export tools to AI agent hosts through an agentinterop v1 provider
disambiguation: Not a Hangul/HWPX editor or viewer; it only writes .hwpx files and opens them in the system default app.
extras: Desktop only because it uses Node.js fs. No network access, telemetry, or account. Third-party code-block renderers run other plugins' code and are off by default. The agentinterop v1 provider is the author's own convention, not an official standard; Verbex (EverydayMind/obsidian-verbex) is currently the only agent host implementing it. Converter derived from pypandoc-hwpx (MIT); bundles marked, JSZip, fast-xml-parser, gray-matter.
problem: Obsidian has no way to produce Hangul (Hancom Office) HWPX documents from notes, and plugin-controlled styling cannot match a Korean office document's formatting.

requires.name: Hangul (Hancom Office) or another HWPX viewer

summary: Exporter that converts Markdown notes to Hangul HWPX documents using formatting markers from an HWPX template.
